Title: IFileHandlerFactory - File Handler Aggregator
Summary: Aggregates all IFileHandler instances in a kernel and provides unified access for file attachment processing. Kernel-locked.
Content:
## IFileHandlerFactory

**Namespace**: `Cyrena.Contracts`
**Assembly**: `Cyrena.Core`

### Purpose
Provides easier access to all `IFileHandler` instances registered in a `Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Kernel`. Kernel-locked (one instance per chat).

### Properties
| Property | Type | Description |
|----------|------|-------------|
| `HasFileHandlers` | `bool` | True if any file handlers are registered |

### Methods

#### CanHandleType(string contentType, string fileName)
Checks if any registered handler can process the given file type.

```csharp
bool CanHandleType(string contentType, string fileName);
```

#### GetMessageContent(Stream data, string contentType, string name)
Delegates to the appropriate handler to convert stream data into `AdditionalMessageContent` for display.

```csharp
Task<AdditionalMessageContent?> GetMessageContent(Stream data, string contentType, string name);
```

#### GetMessageContent(byte[] data, string contentType, string name)
Delegates to the appropriate handler to convert byte array data into `AdditionalMessageContent` for display.

```csharp
Task<AdditionalMessageContent?> GetMessageContent(byte[] data, string contentType, string name);
```

#### GetKernelContent(Stream data, string contentType, string name)
Delegates to the appropriate handler to convert stream data into `KernelContent` for the Semantic Kernel.

```csharp
Task<KernelContent?> GetKernelContent(Stream data, string contentType, string name);
```

#### GetKernelContent(byte[] data, string contentType, string name)
Delegates to the appropriate handler to convert byte array data into `KernelContent` for the Semantic Kernel.

```csharp
Task<KernelContent?> GetKernelContent(byte[] data, string contentType, string name);
```

#### GetSupportedMimeTypes()
Returns the union of all MIME types supported by registered handlers.

```csharp
string[] GetSupportedMimeTypes();
```

#### GetExtension(string mimeType)
Returns the file extension for a given MIME type based on handler mappings.

```csharp
string? GetExtension(string mimeType);
```

### Usage
Used by chat components and connections to process file attachments without directly iterating handlers.

```csharp
if (fileHandlerFactory.CanHandleType("image/png", "screenshot.png"))
{
    var content = await fileHandlerFactory.GetKernelContent(stream, "image/png", "screenshot.png");
}
```

### Related
- `IFileHandler` - Individual file handler contract
- `AdditionalMessageContent` - Wrapper for kernel content
- `IConnection` - Uses file handlers for message processing
